tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per the tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should be a Firm or Company registered in India. Joint Ventures and Consortiums are not allowed
Applicant should have been in existence for a period of at least three (3) years

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have office in Bengaluru, Karnataka If the Applicant does not have an office in Bengaluru, the Applicant should submit an undertaking stating that they shall open an office in Bengaluru within 30 days of receipt of Letter of Indent / Notification of Award.
